verdict.rationale: AutoGen documents its own portability features: teams are defined in a declarative JSON specification, Studio can export teams as Python code, and components can be serialized and deserialized. These cover configuration and team definitions, but nothing shows a complete export of all user data such as conversation history, memory or run results. missing for 10: documented export of all user data (chat histories, memory stores, run outputs) in open formats, an explicit offboarding/exit workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
